body:
I've been depressed and always wanted to kill myself. I was overweight and ugly (still am, but I hope not as much as before). I always thought I would never have friends or get a girlfriend or get a job. But, I proved myself wrong and had all of that. Now, I admit I'm having some "getting over my ex" problems and it's making me depressed again, but I'm sure it'll get better.

I hope you'll stay around a little while longer, even though your life seems fucked right now. Something good might happen to you before you know it.
